prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 中文 · 财务指标 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "指标" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 154px
  col 2: header "2022 年" · longest unbreakable word 45px · one-line width 57px
  col 3: header "2023 年" · longest unbreakable word 45px · one-line width 57px
  col 4: header "2024 年" · longest unbreakable word 43px · one-line width 57px
  col 5: header "同比" · longest unbreakable word 54px · one-line width 54px
  col 6: header "备注" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 276px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
This table cannot fit without splitting words at 360px. You MAY choose a total wider than 359px (the reader then scrolls horizontally), or squeeze and accept splits — a design decision.
Rendering convention: the screenshot always shows the WHOLE table. Anything beyond the dashed box is not clipped; it is the part a reader reaches by scrolling sideways, so judge both what fits in the box at first sight and the cost of scrolling to the rest.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示五项财务指标在 2022—2024 年的变化，以及同比结果和备注。","reading":"读者先按行识别指标，再横向比较三个年度的数值和同比变化；备注提供补充解释。","groups":["第 2—4 列都是年度数值，应保持一致的宽度和对齐方式，方便跨年比较。","第 5 列是变化结果，与年度数值相邻，便于核对趋势。","第 1 列标识指标，第 6 列提供说明，分别承担识别和解释作用。"],"keep_intact":["年度数值及百分比","同比变化数值及其单位或符号","指标名称中的单位","年份表头"],"may_wrap":["指标名称可在自然语义边界换行。","备注中的说明文字可以自然换行；同一行较高时可容纳这些换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [105, 66, 66, 66, 75, 120] · table 499×381px · row heights [60, 60, 60, 83, 83, 36] · column headers wrapped 3/6 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 139px
Design r2B: widths [86, 66, 66, 66, 75, 120] · table 480×405px · row heights [60, 60, 60, 83, 83, 60] · column headers wrapped 3/6 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 120px
Design r2C: widths [145, 66, 66, 66, 75, 120] · table 539×381px · row heights [60, 60, 60, 83, 83, 36] · column headers wrapped 3/6 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 179px

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"三年数值列等宽，便于横向比较；指标名称和数值没有词中拆分，行内关系较清楚。","problems":"三个年份表头都分成两行，首屏仅能看到同比列的一部分，备注需要横向滚动。较长的指标名称和备注使部分行达到三行。","cause":"年度列各为66px，扣除21px内边距和边框后不足以容纳57px的年份表头；指标列105px、备注列120px限制了长文本的行宽。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"年度列保持一致，数值与同比结果仍完整；总宽比r2A少19px，首屏能看到更多右侧内容。","problems":"指标名称换行更零碎，经营性现金流及其单位被拆到多行，资产负债率也被拆开；末行因此变高，识别指标的速度下降。年份表头仍分两行。","cause":"指标列从105px缩至86px，可用文本宽度只有65px；年度列仍为66px，放不下一行年份表头。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"较宽的指标列让大多数指标名称保持一行，标签易于识别；年度列等宽，数值比较清楚。","problems":"首屏几乎看不到同比结果，滚动距离最长；表格高度与r2A相同，额外的指标列宽没有缩短整表。年份表头仍分两行。","cause":"指标列增至145px，将同比和备注进一步推到视口之外；年度列仍为66px，而较长备注仍会决定部分行高。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"year-headers","widths":[105,78,78,78,75,120],"change":"以r2A为基础，将三年列统一加宽至78px，使57px的年份表头能够一行显示；保留指标和同比的完整性，接受更多横向滚动。"},{"name":"more-note-space","widths":[105,78,78,78,75,150],"change":"保持年份表头完整，并把备注列加宽至150px，检验较长说明能否减少换行和行高；代价是滚动距离增加。"},{"name":"compact-scan","widths":[99,66,66,66,75,135],"change":"保留较紧凑的年度列以改善首屏可见范围，将部分宽度转给备注；指标列略窄于r2A，检验标签换行是否仍自然，并与年份表头单行的方案比较。"}]}
